sequence: KIITO robots and top-page policy link were obtained, but the web tool could not return the policy body.
The initial batch was started before the direct-fetch fallback had completed the full policy review. The initial protocol's reviewed-policy statement was premature.

The full policy contained content-use restrictions outside personal use or other legally permitted cases. Rather than infer permission for potential product evaluation, KIITO was excluded conservatively.

The initial parent batch and identified child process were stopped. One KIITO trial had already completed; the parent printed a start for the next museum trial before termination. None of this initial batch is pooled into the final six trials.
The resumed batch uses the reviewed museum site only and all three Goals are fixed in a new v2 protocol before its trials. Production code remains unchanged.
scopeOfCorrection: This is a process error in site selection, not evidence of a KIITO UX defect and not a legal conclusion about all automated reading. Original local logs remain intact; no screenshots or raw website logs are committed or publicly published.
preventRecurrence: Require a successful full-text policy review before marking a candidate reviewed or invoking the public runner. Robots alone or a policy URL alone cannot satisfy that preflight. If scope restrictions cannot be enforced by the current runner, exclude the candidate rather than rely on a prompt.
